description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Lists the referral requests the signed-in user sent on techjobs.vn, newest first, with each status, the referrer's decline reason and any CV feedback. Requests the user received as a referrer are in list_referrer_requests.
name: list_referral_requests

cv_feedback.description: What the referrer asked to fix in the CV chính (status needs_changes).

decline_reason.description: Why the referrer declined, when they gave a reason.

status_label.description: The status as techjobs.vn shows it (Vietnamese).

title: List my referral requests
